name: KPJ
recent: KPJ Healthcare 公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，净利按年增长 13% 至 1.063 亿令吉，并宣布每股 1.20 仙中期股息。同期，雇员公积金局（EPF）和退休基金局（KWAP）等主要股东在 10 月至 11 月间有多笔股权变动申报。
notable: 2026 财年第三季度净利按年增长 13% 至 1.063 亿令吉。
宣布每股 1.20 仙的单层中期股息，除权日为 2026 年 12 月 8 日。
在 Ampang Puteri 医院开设拥有 33 张床位的国际病房。
risks: 主要股东 EPF 和 KWAP 在近期有多笔股权变动申报，需留意后续持股变化。
earnings: 2026 财年第二季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 11.968 亿令吉，按季增长 14.0%，按年增长 16.9%；净利为 1.039 亿令吉，按季增长 49.2%，按年增长 26.6%；净利率从上一季度的 6.6% 提升至 8.7%。

recent_en: KPJ Healthcare reported a 13% year-on-year rise in 3Q FY2026 net profit to RM106.3 million and declared an interim dividend of 1.20 sen per share. Meanwhile, substantial shareholders including EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in shareholding between October and November.
notable_en: 3Q FY2026 net profit rose 13% year-on-year to RM106.3 million.
Declared a single-tier interim dividend of 1.20 sen per share, with ex-date on 8 December 2026.
Opened a 33-bed international ward at Ampang Puteri Hospital.
risks_en: Substantial shareholders EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in shareholding recently; further changes in their stakes should be monitored.
earnings_en: For 2Q FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM1,196.8 million, up 14.0% QoQ and 16.9% YoY; net income was RM103.9 million, up 49.2% QoQ and 26.6% YoY; net margin improved to 8.7% from 6.6% in the previous quarter.
